case_fields_required: Case name and question are both required
tolerance_invalid: Tolerance must be an integer between 0 and 100 (percent)
datasource_not_found: The datasource does not exist in this workspace
run_not_finished: Only finished runs can be promoted
no_run_as_admin: No enabled workspace admin to run the regression as — assign one and retry
case_needs_clarify: The case question triggers a clarification pause — make the question more specific
baseline_captured: First run — baseline captured, comparison starts next run
sums_unavailable: Numeric SUM probe failed — this case is compared by row count only
api_run_forbidden: Only workspace admins may trigger regression runs via API
